name: Mercat Brut Rose
description: Pale salmon pink in color with zesty aromas of citrus, wild strawberry and fennel. Apple, berry and brioche flavors are balanced on a firm structure of mineral acidity and fine bubbles.

name: Marques de Caceres Brut
description: Pale straw color revived by fine bubbles. Bouquet of citrus fruits with notes of brioche with a refreshing, balanced structure.

name: III Lustros Grand Reserva
description: Creamy texture and finesse of the bubbles with very attractive smoke and candied lemon-peel nose. Dried fruits and honey on the nose and palate with a long finish.

name: Los Bermejos
description: Pleasant nose with white flowers and the dry palate is supple with good freshness and a honeyed, slightly exotic with ripe peach and orange zest notes on the finish.

name: Segura Viudas Heredad
description: Straw yellow in color, with a small, fine, plentiful mousse with aromas of aging on lees, lightly smokey.

name: Segura Viudas Aria Brut
description: Dry and lively with flavors of pineapple, almonds, honey, pears and fresh bread.

name: Flor de Muga
description: An elegant, pale pink colour with very marked aromatic intensity. Complex nose with stone fruit aromas (peach, nectarine), citrus fruit, white blossom.

name: Muga Rose
description: Bright pink color with nectarine and tangerine on the nose, and cantaloupe and peach on the palate and a long finish.

name: Hacienda Rose
description: Intense presence of red fruits with pronounced citric notes, flowers. Velvety, refined and elegant.

name: Shaya
description: Well balanced, complex with a distinct minerality which augments the abundance of fruit flavors.

name: Shaya Habis
description: Grapes are specially selected and aged in oak, creating a richer more complex wine.

name: La Caña Navia
description: Aromas of orange, nectarine, citrus, and touch of anise. Mineral-tinged finishing flavors of pear and orange peel.

name: Tarima
description: Floral aromas with stone fruit, very expressive, balanced, and aromatic.

name: Muga Blanco
description: Crisp aromas of green apple and citrus fruit with white peach, grapefruit and hints of oak on the palate.

name: Gessami
description: White flowers, jasmine, orange blossom, and rose. Aromas of anise and chamomile tea. Table grape, pineapple, peach, and a citric breeze.

name: El Coto Blanco
description: Apple blossom, apricot, pear and hazelnut on the nose. Full-bodied with fresh acidity, fruity, spicy and a waxy texture.

name: Polvorete
description: Nice phenolic structure to the zesty, round palate. Medium to full body, with lemon zest, mineral and some oyster shells followed by a mouthwatering finish.

name: La Revelia
description: Rich with lots of freshness, with pineapple, honey cream and mango notes, infused with floral, baking spice. Graceful, with lots of complexity through the citrusy finish.

name: Inazio Urruzola
description: Intense aromas of citrus and white flowers, ripe tropical fruit on the base gives complexity and character.

name: Ramon Bilbao
description: Green pears, grapefruit, jasmine and melon rind on the nose. Crunchy and fresh with a medium body and crisp, refreshing finish.

name: Hacienda Arinzano Blanco
description: Notes of citrus fruits, such as lemon and orange peel, with nuances of exotic fruit, such as pear and mango. Long and balanced finish.

name: Mar de Frades
description: Aromas of stone fruits, like apricot, medlar fruit, along with almond flowers and subtle tropical salt notes. Has an elegant freshness and complexity.

name: Pazo Barrantes Gran Vino
description: Elegant, insinuating, perfumed, floral and subtle. Very vibrant, and it's fresh and with mandarin orange peel–infused acidity, with tropical hints of guava and pineapple flavors.

name: Atance
description: Aromas of bramble berry, black olive, and coffee. Medium-bodied with bright red fruit flavors, a hint of spice, wild herbs and a citric note on the finish.

name: Can Blau
description: Full bodied, a smooth and fruity initial burst with classic raspberry and black cherry flavors.

name: Alto Moncayo Veraton
description: Aromas of dark cherries, plums, raisins, sweet spices and cigar box. Full-bodied and rich, ripe and velvety with a flavorful spicy finish.

name: Vatan
description: Full-bodied with glossy tannins; juicy, chewy and nicely balanced with ripe blackberry and integrated oak.

name: Laurel
description: Round and powerful but harmonious with good freshness. Nicely textured, powerful and elegant. Ripe berries, spice and herbs and a touch of smoke.

name: Clos Erasmus
description: Freshness with notes of orange blossom, floral character and incredible complexity. Blood orange, spice and cassis. Great purity, complexity, elegance and finesse.

name: El Coto Crianza
description: Balanced with notes of raspberry, cherry, spice and toasted note that lead to a silky finish.

name: Viña Alberdi Reserva
description: Fresh aromas of ripe fruit, wild strawberries, currants and raspberries against a balsamic background with notes of vanilla, toasted caramel, bakery, coffee and sweet mints.

name: Viña Ardanza
description: Soft freshness, nice structure, and delicately elegant tannins with hints of sweet cherries and black currant chocolate, assembled with notes of black pepper, tobacco, nutmeg, coffee, mocha and cinnamon.

name: Muga Seleccion Especial
description: Suave wine with earthy, crushed cherry flavors. Gentle acidity and tannins.

name: Prado Enea Grand Reserva
description: The most structured Prado Enea ever. A reduced center palate that is so compact with dark fruit, dark mushrooms and cedary spice.

name: Torre Muga
description: Deep purple in color, with aromas of ripe dark fruit, spicy notes of black pepper, mineral hints of graphite. Smooth soft tannins, elegant and balanced acidity.

name: Coto de Imaz Reserva
description: Intense cherry color with garnet edge, with ripe fruit and fine cocoa, velvety and ripe tannins.

name: Grand Reserva 904
description: Very intense nose, with mint chocolate vanilla and roasted coffee lead into notes of jammy fruit. Balanced structure with pleasant acidity and ultra-fine tannins providing a long and complex finish.

name: Juan Gil Blue
description: Purple/black in color, with nose of pain grillé, graphite, earth tones, spice box, black fruits, and a hint of balsamic. Opens in the glass to reveal savory flavors and a lengthy, pure finish.

name: Clio
description: Opaque purple color with an expressive nose of brier, mineral, blueberry and blackberry fruit leading to a plush, opulent wine with great density, savory flavors and a lengthy finish.

name: Coto de Imaz Gran Reserva
description: Aromas of spiced cherries, blueberries, orange peel, savory plums with chocolate and vanilla. Creamy tannins with dark fruit and long finish.

name: El Nido
description: Scents of blueberry, boysenberry, tobacco, licorice and vanilla bean. Juicy and firmly built with suave candied dark fruit flavors accented by floral and Asian spice qualities. Impressively long finish.

name: Juan Gil Silver
description: Full bodied wine with dark cherry color and powerful aromas of red berries, toasted and smoked notes.

name: Tinto Pesquera
description: Elegant and soft with aromas of red fruit, dark cherries, vanilla, and nutmeg. Silky on the mid-palate with well-rounded tannins and a velvety finish.

name: Malleolus
description: Rich flavors of blackberry, currant, toast and mineral which are harmonious over well-integrated tannins showing balance and a long finish of spice and smoke.

name: Zarihs
description: The nose has a powerful impression of blackberries with a hint of wood smoke and sweet vanilla. Flavors of dark berries dominate; wild blackberries and dried plums with notes of espresso coffee.

name: Emilio Moro
description: Blueberry and plum-cake character. Full, but quite supple tannins with blackberry and chocolaty oak on the palate and intense finish.

name: Finca Resalso
description: Ripe black cherry color with ripe red berry hints (mulberry and blackcurrant) intermingled with elegant, balsamic, oaky aromas.

name: Termes
description: Balanced wine with blackberry, chocolate and walnut aromas, fruit-driven, with fine tannins.

name: Marques de Murrieta Reserva
description: Concentrated and spicy with a hint of pepper in the nose. A generous yet polished red, still fresh, with plum, mineral, and coffee bean.

name: Blue Grey
description: Ripe black fruit and cherry flavors that are focused and accented by herbal mineral and spicy notes.

name: Honoro Vera
description: Bright acidity, integrated tannins with pepper, plum, fig, blackberry, leather, black raisin, smoke, tobacco, and dark chocolate notes.

name: Clar de Basc
description: Fresh pithy fruit on the nose with notes of cherry, red currant, raspberry and blackberry. Elegant on the palate, with fresh berry fruit and hints of liquorice with a long mineral-spicy finish.

name: Codorniu Zero Rose
description: A pleasant non-alcoholic sparkling rosé.

name: Codorniu Zero
description: A pleasant non-alcoholic sparkling wine made with the white Airén.

name: Shania White 0.0
description: Citrus aromas with hints of lime and white flowers on the nose.

name: Shania Red 0.0
description: Intense flavors of dark cherries, blueberries and hints of plum.
